description: This PHP script appears to be a test client for the TestLink project's XML-RPC API. It constructs and sends multiple test requests to create test projects with various configurations, utilizing an external IXR_Client class for XML-RPC communication. The script includes setup for API keys, test descriptions, and options for project properties, and it outputs test progress messages.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used for making XML-RPC calls, instantiated as part of the test client to communicate with the server.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a sample API database message, likely for informational purposes.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a test by sending an XML-RPC request with specified method and arguments, and possibly handling the response.
